name: rpi_wireless_off
description: Powers off a Raspberry Pi 4's Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chips at boot, without restart loops
author: squadgazzz

volumio_info.details: Powers off the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chips of a Raspberry Pi 4, Pi 400 or Compute Module 4 at boot, and keeps Volumio's Bluetooth and Wi-Fi services from restarting in a loop while they're gone.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.1: Refuses to install on boards other than the Pi 4, Pi 400 and CM4, and the boot generator does nothing on them.
